project_tracker_diagnostic: Tall perennial with conspicuously winged/decurrent stems and many white heads; famous for extruding ice ribbons in winter.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common or useful Central Texas fall/white composite for field learning.

morphology_keys.habit: Tall erect herb, often in colonies.
morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate; lower leaves often opposite or subopposite; blades toothed and decurrent, creating winged stems.
morphology_keys.heads: Many white ray florets around pale disk florets in branched inflorescences.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cypselae somewhat flattened, pappus reduced or absent.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
